# Gireesh Kumar S — Founder, Director & CEO of Nova Innovations

> Gireesh Kumar S is an advertising pioneer with over 27 years of industry leadership in turnkey Out-of-Home (OOH) media, highway billboard infrastructure, and mobile transit branding across Kerala, India. Under his direction, Nova Innovations manages 500+ prime media assets across all 14 districts, delivering complete A-to-Z lifecycle execution: strategic media planning, direct space hosting, in-house studio design, industrial flex printing, physical crane placement, and 24/7 site illumination and structural maintenance.

## Executive Profile & Core Leadership
- **Role**: Founder, Director & Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
- **Company**: Nova Innovations (https://novainnovations.in)
- **Domain**: Turnkey Outdoor Media Infrastructure, Highway Hoardings, KSRTC Bus Transit Advertising, Rapid Statewide Deployment
- **Experience**: 27+ Years of continuous operations in Kerala media corridors.
- **Headquarters**: Thiruvananthapuram (Trivandrum / TVM), Kerala, India.

## Turnkey A-to-Z Execution Model
Under Gireesh Kumar S's leadership, Nova Innovations is structured not merely as a design studio, but as a complete outdoor media infrastructure powerhouse:
1. **Strategic Media Planning & Footfall Analytics**: High-impact site selection along major traffic corridors.
2. **Space Hosting & Exclusive Corridors**: Ownership and leasing of 500+ prime billboard and unipole sites across Kerala and TVM.
3. **In-House Creative Design Studio**: High-recall campaign creative direction and 3D visual visibility previews.
4. **Large-Format Industrial Printing**: High-durability solvent, eco-solvent, and star flex printing.
5. **Physical Overnight Placement**: Certified crane operators and steel riggers executing simultaneous statewide installations within 24 hours.
6. **24/7 Illumination & Maintenance**: Nightly lighting audits, structural safety checks, and storm weatherproofing.

## Prime Corridors in Trivandrum (TVM) & Kerala
- **Trivandrum (TVM)**: Kazhakkoottam & Technopark Phase 1-3 Bypass, Kowdiar Avenue, MG Road (Palayam, Statue, Overbridge), Bakery Junction, Panavila, Pettah, Pattom, East Fort, Vellayambalam, and the Vizhinjam International Seaport NH 66 corridor.
- **National Highways**: NH 66 Corridor (Trivandrum – Kollam – Alappuzha – Kochi – Kozhikode), NH 544 (Kochi – Thrissur – Palakkad), and MC Road.

## Key Brand Partnerships
Trusted by leading national and regional enterprises including myG, Bhima Jewellery, Bank of Baroda, Pothys, Muthoot Group, Havells, Medimix, KSRTC, Oxygen Digital Shop, Loka Medicity, and Kairali Foods.
